CREATE TABLE market_impact_cost_log (
    log_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    ordersmark TEXT,
    mic NUMERIC,
    calculated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE recalc_market_impact_cost()
AS $ $
DECLARE
    current_market_factor NUMERIC;
BEGIN
    -- Get the current market factor
    SELECT mkteffect INTO current_market_factor
    FROM systemmonitoring
    ORDER BY systemmonitoringpivot DESC
    LIMIT 1;

    -- Calculate MIC for new orders and log the values
    INSERT INTO market_impact_cost_log (ordersmark, mic)
    SELECT
        o.recordvault,
        (o.notionsum * current_market_factor) AS calculated_mic
    FROM
        orders o
    WHERE
        o.orderflow = 'New';
END;
$ $ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
